proposals.rationale: Paragraph (d)(1) explicitly exempts persons who passed a pilot proficiency check or practical test from the flight review required under paragraph (c) to act as pilot in command.
Paragraph (d)(2) explicitly exempts persons who passed specified practical tests from the flight review required under paragraph (c) to act as pilot in command.

Paragraph (e) explicitly exempts persons who satisfactorily accomplished one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program from the flight review required under paragraph (c) to act as pilot in command.
Paragraph (f) explicitly exempts flight instructors meeting recent experience or refresher requirements from the 1 hour of ground training baseline required under paragraph (a).
Paragraph (g) explicitly exempts student pilots undergoing training for a certificate with a current solo endorsement from the flight review required under paragraph (c) to act as pilot in command.
